This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and scales, with pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]], solid black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], large lips, and sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], two members of this species came into conflict with some [[Ubuugan]]s in [[Gorb Drig's cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorliss]].<ref name="MJ4" />

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ4" />
